jsonSchema.title: Actorwright protocol v2 scoped help result

pathConventions.cli: CLI path options use absolute K-local filesystem paths under the admitted workspace.
pathConventions.documents: JSON document paths use workspace-relative or explicitly project-relative forward-slash paths. Follow the base and exceptions declared by each document schema.
pathConventions.assets: Asset fields use their declared Data-relative, textures-relative, or meshes-relative paths. Overlay omission comparison and package-destination admission normalize one leading separator, casing and slashes. Rooted active overlays, UNC/device paths, drives and traversal remain refused; immutable source documents and other AssetPath values retain their bytes and casing.

contract.name: npc finish analyze
contract.purpose: Analyze a hash-bound world-clean Finish Core request and write a new proposal.
limitations: Finish Core authors follower, explicit optional AIDT, outfit, inventory, and a self-contained editor-location routine only; --validate-all is non-promoting and accumulates safely reachable phase diagnostics; no CELL, ACHR, placement, runtime, or visual authority is included.

Callable without an operator review receipt. Human visual acceptance remains required; receipt-free successors cannot authorize Exchange packaging or promotion. Supplied receipts must match exact workflow bindings.

A master-owned CSTY seed-required diagnostic offers npc finish analyze recovery: set combatPolicy.seedLocalStyle=true, retain copied master/provider hash authority, rehash the request, and reanalyze. Missing or duplicate CSTY evidence does not authorize that recovery.

options.description: New Finish Core proposal output outside validation mode.
Optional validation mode; exactly true or 1 accumulates safely reachable phase diagnostics without publishing the proposal.
Optional external-install context; --data-root and --plugins must be supplied together.
Optional complete enabled order; --data-root and --plugins must be supplied together.
Uppercase physical SHA-256 binding the workflow bundle.

effects.condition: When admitting the exact request and optional paired install context.
Only outside --validate-all true or 1 after request analysis succeeds.
Only in --validate-all true or 1 mode for disposable validation output; nothing is promoted.
When the operation journal is available.

authority.reason: Exact hash-bound Finish documents and optional paired install context are admitted.
Finish documents bind the source/provider identity used by the transaction.
Fresh Finish output is bound to admitted inputs and pinned tools.
Analyze/apply output still requires the independent verify phase.
Finish Core does not render an off-engine preview.
Static Finish evidence does not establish human visual acceptance.
Static Finish evidence does not establish game-runtime behavior.
Finish Core success never grants promotion approval.

inputArtifacts.description: Exact predecessor workflow bound by path and physical SHA-256.
Optional exact operator receipt; when supplied it must bind the predecessor and is independently validated.

outputArtifacts.description: Fresh Finish Core proposal outside validation mode.
Fresh successor; receipt-free Finish remains review-required through independent verification.

contract.resultDescription: Typed Finish outcome and optional nonpromoting validation report; artifacts and next actions bind the exact static workflow.

jsonSchema.title: Actorwright Finish Core request v1

packageRoot.description: Workspace-root-relative path (repository-relative in the standard invocation) to the full source package root, not its Data subdirectory.

packageManifest.description: Workspace-root-relative path to the verified package manifest; it must be a direct child of packageRoot.

packageTreeSha256.description: SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes formed from every recursively enumerated file under packageRoot, including packageManifest. For each file, replace '\' with '/' in its relative path and emit <relativePath>|<byteLength>|<uppercaseFileSha256> followed by LF. Sort rows ordinally by relativePath before concatenation. Reparse-point files are refused.

pluginPath.description: Workspace-root-relative path to the source plugin; it must resolve inside packageRoot and its final segment must equal plugin.

plugin.description: Bare safe filename for the source plugin, with no directory components.

providers.description: Provider plugin identities and paths must each be unique, and every provider file must be declared by the source package.

plugin.description: Bare safe filename for the provider plugin, with no directory components.

path.description: Workspace-root-relative path that must resolve inside source.packageRoot and whose final segment must equal plugin.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact provider file bytes.

byteLength.description: Positive byte length of the exact provider file.

defensiveOnly.description: Must be true. Finish Core authors only the closed zero-offense defensive combat style.

aiPolicy.description: Optional complete Skyrim NPC AIDT authoring policy. When omitted, the source AIDT bytes are preserved. A recruitable NPC may not remain HelpsNobody.

outfitRacePolicy.description: Every selected ARMO armature must admit the actor race through its primary or additional race list. clone allocates output-owned ARMA with the race appended, affected ARMO with retargeted armatures, and a private OTFT. Only hash-bound copied providers are read.

formId.description: A hexadecimal FormID accepted by Actorwright; canonical emission uses 0xXXXXXXXX.

nullableFormId.description: A hexadecimal FormID accepted by Actorwright; canonical emission uses 0xXXXXXXXX.

jsonSchema.canonicalization: Editable Finish request, proposal and manifest reads accept SHA-256 of raw UTF-8 bytes or the typed canonical serialization. Canonical JSON has ordinally sorted object keys, unchanged array order, no insignificant whitespace or BOM, and lowercase typed SHA-256 values. Unknown and duplicate members are refused. Internal document bindings use canonical identity. Proposal identity omits proposalSha256; the legacy self-excluding digest remains accepted in addition to raw and full canonical hashes. Embedded proposal identity is independently checked. Binary files, package inventory, receipts and external authority artifacts retain their exact byte bindings.

digestRule.source.packageTreeSha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes formed from every recursively enumerated file under packageRoot, including packageManifest. For each file, replace '\' with '/' in its relative path and emit <relativePath>|<byteLength>|<uppercaseFileSha256> followed by LF. Sort rows ordinally by relativePath before concatenation. Reparse-point files are refused.
digestRule.manifest.packageTreeSha256: For new outputs begin the SHA-256 input with UTF-8 npc.finish-core.output-tree.v2 followed by NUL, then ordinally sorted forward-slash relative paths. For each included file append UTF-8 relativePath, NUL, raw file bytes, NUL. Exclude the output plugin path (ordinal-ignore-case), paths beginning NPCManager/Evidence/ or Data/NPCManager/Evidence/ (ordinal), README-Finish-Core.txt (ordinal), and the generated root npcmanager-package.json (ordinal). The generated generic manifest is independently reconstructed from the retained NPCManager/finish-core-source-package-manifest.json bytes bound to the request source manifest hash, plus exact final file hashes. The retained member is included in the new output digest, so external verification needs no original source folder. Legacy output manifests retain the unprefixed historical digest including npcmanager-package.json. Ordinary files only; no reparse points or devices.
digestRule.manifest.sourcePackageTreeSha256: Ordinary v1 manifest: the unprefixed path-NUL-bytes-NUL digest over the source package, excluding only its plugin path (ordinal-ignore-case). External v2 manifest: the source.packageTreeSha256 inventory digest including packageManifest. These are distinct existing hash domains.

Exclude the output plugin path (ordinal-ignore-case), paths beginning NPCManager/Evidence/ or Data/NPCManager/Evidence/ (ordinal), README-Finish-Core.txt (ordinal), and the generated root npcmanager-package.json (ordinal). The generated generic manifest is independently reconstructed from the retained NPCManager/finish-core-source-package-manifest.json bytes bound to the request source manifest hash, plus exact final file hashes. The retained member is included in the new output digest, so external verification needs no original source folder. Legacy output manifests retain the unprefixed historical digest including npcmanager-package.json. Ordinary files only; no reparse points or devices.
digestRule.manifest.sourcePackageTreeSha256: Ordinary v1 manifest: the unprefixed path-NUL-bytes-NUL digest over the source package, excluding only its plugin path (ordinal-ignore-case). External v2 manifest: the source.packageTreeSha256 inventory digest including packageManifest. These are distinct existing hash domains.
